class.name: WorldDecorator
class.brief_description: Abstract reusable configuration for a world modification.
class.description: Subclasses compile their settings into immutable terrain modifiers. Editing a resource does not change an already generated preview until it is regenerated. Shared resources remain shared configurations; use separate resources when independently authored settings are desired. Resources may be attached at different container levels. Full override and antidecorator behavior is not implemented in this slice.

members.member: Whether this attachment participates in the next generated snapshot.
Lower values execute earlier. Equal values retain scene-tree preorder and local list order. Priority is independent of scope inheritance.
